content: Nanonets/Rossum pattern: AI flags uncertain fields for human review with the source region highlighted; system learns from corrections over time (no per-sender template needed for Rossum's cognitive model, but Nanonets and Docparser use more template/rule-based approaches keyed to a source format). No public evidence of an explicit 'per-sender profile' UI feature — the learning is usually implicit/statistical, not an explicit named saved-profile object.
